answer: Simultaneous presence checks. In one short global window, each account's operator answers a fresh challenge in a supervised booth. A credential vault records one attendance per person; staff reject screen relays or a mirror image as a participant. Operators cannot wander between booths to claim twice before the window closes. N eligible accounts require N people and their recruitment and attendance costs. This assumes reliable deduplication across venues and honest supervision; bribed staff can defeat the rule.
